// diagnostic

E0148

A str-match pattern used in an `if == {}` table with no `else` arm (D-PARSESTR1)

What

A str-match pattern used in an `if == {}` table with no `else` arm (D-PARSESTR1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Add an `else` arm to cover values that do not match the str pattern.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0148: tests/ui/parse_pattern_no_else.stderr.

Error [E0148]: This `if` matches text but has no `else` arm
  --> tests/ui/parse_pattern_no_else.jet:3:5
    |
  3 |     if input == {
    |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A text pattern can always fail to match — the fixed text might differ, or a typed hole might not read as that type
 Fix: Add `else -> { ... }` to handle text that doesn't match
